kappa_family_couplings: Equal singular values within a family mass matrix are not assumed. M_Li/M_Le=sqrt(m_i/m_e) with common Yukawa per multiplet; E/L ratio is free.
scope: Continuous finite-dimensional true U(3) actions commuting with SM, fundamental lepton doublet. Four-dimensional local chiral theory with fermionic UV anomaly cancellation. Pure step thresholds, no kinetic mixing in the low energy EFT, top-only one-loop SM quartic transport; extra heavy lepton masses electroweak invariant. Masses are witnesses, not search-approved spectra.
